notes.title: v0.3 Farm Planting System
notes.notes: [h2]New content[/h2][h3][b]Brand new Farm  planting system[/b][/h3][p]You can build planters to plant various vegetables. including: tomatoes, watermelons, potatoes, corn, carrots, cucumbers， Weather changes, sunlight and moonlight will affect plant growth, water and fertilize, and maintain crops. More crops and even fruit trees will be updated in the future[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/bc3bdc96233c96a9f35d15a5a5b1893afb9bcd0d.png"][/img][/p][p]How to plant?[/p][p]First, you need to buy crop seeds from the NPC indigenous trader, Craft a Farm plan through the player-made list, hold it with the right mouse button to open the circular menu and select the planter to place on the ground, then select the seeds and place them on the planter.[/p][p]Craft a watering can, Right click on the plant to open the menu. First, you need to collect water, make pesticides and fertilizers, and irrigate, spray pesticides, remove and fertilize.[/p][p]Some tips: Crops will be automatically irrigated in rainy weather. Crop will stop growing when Plant health value is less than 50%, so spray with pesticides in time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/0ae3c835a00f275e75d0f8ae8f3706f3569363d2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/c5d4cfbd5e44a32c1617f450b03dda35a9d48187.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/829c5badcbcb58bef85adf8813a7fe221f9ded1c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]New seabed environment, add algae, rocks, pink coral, school of fish particles, etc.[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/c55506dfb26298bc7a0b964693097c702bba4d3d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/22e04cdae61dad0ad3a2db83985a4e88ce5c9b58.png"][/img][/p][h2]Bug Fixes and improvements:[/h2][list][*][p]You can enter the quantity to buy or sell items in batches[/p][/*][*][p]Set the night luminous material of the bamboo fishing rod, fishing line and fishing float[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug that the bamboo fishing rod reminds that the backpack is full when picking up the catch[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the number of marine animal AI populations by 5 times, so that they are distributed in the vast sea area[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug that the player's footsteps cannot be played normally[/p][/*][*][p]The wall lamp will automatically turn off 30 minutes after construction and each time it is turned on to prevent too many light sources from reducing fps. Turn off the wall lamp and torch lighting shadows to increase the frame rate[/p][/*][*][p]The item production queue should display the item name instead of the id name[/p][/*][*][p]Fix  the chat message does not display the history and cannot be scrolled back. Press enter to display the old message.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix long messages are not fully displayed and need to be zoomed in and out.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Slow message disappearance speed[/p][/*][*][p]Fish AI generated in shallow seas seem to float in the air. They should swim to deep sea or shallow water areas without generating AI[/p][/*][*][p]Optimize and improve frame rate[/p][/*][*][p]Further optimize lighting, shorten lighting distance, and eliminate lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce bullet production cost and craft time,[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the purchase of saltpeter and sulfur ore from NPC trader, and adjust the order of goods[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the lethality of pistols and sniper rifles[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the number of items such as spears and leather stacking[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the lethality of bows and spears[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the diving time, the default is one minute[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the problem that the Pterosaur dies directly in the sky, and now it will land directly[/p][/*][*][p]Let the two kind of pterosaurs fall to the ground when the HP is 20% left, unable to fly, and can be tamed[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce the consumption rate of pet water and food[/p][/*][*][p]New watermelon[/p][/*][*][p]Localization translation calibration[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dinosaur World is now released!
notes.notes:
Dinosaur World is now released, Since the game is still in the early experience stage, we still need some time to update and improve the game, Please give us feedback in the community. If our game makes you happy, please give a positive review, thank you!
We will initially sell it for less than $1, This is the lowest price ever, Please take advantage of this discount, after continuous updates,, and once the full version of the game is released, we will raise the final price to the $20.
